source.Name: Total population
source.Summary: Population: Total population and distribution by age and sex estimated to be  consistent with the population by age and sex of the (a) 1950, 1960, 1970,  1980, 1990, 2001, 2011 censuses; (b) population register through 2017; (c)  official estimates through 2017; and with estimates of the subsequent  trends in fertility, mortality and international migration.

source.Name: Total fertility rate
source.Summary: Fertility: Total fertility rate and age pattern of fertility based on: registered  births classified by age of mother and the underlying female population by  age through 2017.  In addition, the official estimates of age-specific  fertility rates through 2016 have been considered.

source.Name: Life expectancy at birth
source.Summary: Overall Mortality: Life expectancy at birth and age pattern of mortality based on: (a)  official estimates through 2015; (b) registered deaths by age and sex  available through 2017; (c) International estimates used up to 2017.

source.Name: Infant/child mortality
source.Summary: Child Mortality: Under-five mortality based on: registered infant and child deaths through  2015.

source.Name: International migration
source.Summary: Migration: International migration based on: (a) official figures of net  international migration flows, and assumed subsequent trends in  international migration; (b) estimates derived as the differences between  overall population growth and natural increase.
